recipes.element: phone link in the shared Header template part
recipes.title: Change the header phone link (text and tel: link)
steps: Open {admin_url} and sign in with your builder account. In the left menu select Appearance > Editor.

Under Editor › Patterns › Template parts, select Header. Confirm the field labelled Phone link text currently shows {current_text}, matching the reviewed before-crop; if it differs, stop and ask the Care lead for review.
Click into the field labelled Phone link text, select all of its text and replace it with exactly: {new_text}
Click into the field labelled Phone link URL, select all of its text and replace it with exactly: {new_href}

Select Save and wait for the green notice "Header template part updated.". Then open Settings › Cache; if the page cache is shown as enabled, select Purge all caches and wait for "All caches purged.".
Open {page_urls} at {viewports} widths. Confirm the header phone shows {new_text} and links to {new_href}, then return to the Feluda job card and select Mark done.
recipes.validated_by: Feluda build team on the local demo fixture

recipes.element: site logo image in the shared Header template part
recipes.title: Replace the site logo
steps: Open {admin_url} and sign in with your builder account.
Download the approved replacement image from the Approved image panel on this Feluda job card. Do not use any other file.
In the left menu select Media › Add New Media File, choose the downloaded file and select Upload. Note the file name shown in the "Uploaded …" notice.
Select Appearance › Editor, then Patterns › Template parts › Header. Confirm the field labelled Site logo currently shows {current_text}; if it differs, stop and ask the Care lead for review.
In the field labelled Site logo, select the file you uploaded in step 3.

Select Save and wait for the green notice "Header template part updated.". Then open Settings › Cache; if the page cache is shown as enabled, select Purge all caches and wait for "All caches purged.".
Open {page_urls} at {viewports} widths. Confirm the header shows the approved logo, not stretched or cut off, then return to the Feluda job card and select Mark done.
recipes.validated_by: Feluda build team on the local demo fixture

recipes.element: an existing item of the primary navigation menu
recipes.title: Rename or relink a menu item, or reorder the menu
steps: Open {admin_url} and sign in with your builder account. In the left menu select Appearance › Menus.
Find the row whose Navigation label is exactly {current_text}. If there is no such row, stop and ask the Care lead for review.
In that row, replace the Navigation label with exactly {new_text} and the URL with exactly {new_href}.
Required menu order: {menu_order}. If an order is given, move labels between rows so that rows 1, 2, 3 … read in that order (keep each label with its own URL).

Select Save Menu and wait for the notice "Primary menu has been updated.". Then open Settings › Cache; if the page cache is shown as enabled, select Purge all caches and wait for "All caches purged.".
Open {page_urls} at {viewports} widths (on mobile, tap Menu to open it). Confirm the menu shows {new_text} linking to {new_href}, then return to the Feluda job card and select Mark done.
recipes.validated_by: Feluda build team on the local demo fixture

recipes.element: a new item in the primary navigation menu
recipes.title: Add a new menu item
steps: Open {admin_url} and sign in with your builder account. In the left menu select Appearance › Menus.
Confirm no row already has the Navigation label {new_text}; if one does, stop and ask the Care lead for review.
In the first empty row, enter the Navigation label {new_text} and the URL {new_href}.
Required menu order: {menu_order}. If an order is given, move labels between rows so that rows 1, 2, 3 … read in that order (keep each label with its own URL).

Select Save Menu and wait for the notice "Primary menu has been updated.". Then open Settings › Cache; if the page cache is shown as enabled, select Purge all caches and wait for "All caches purged.".
Open {page_urls} at {viewports} widths (on mobile, tap Menu to open it). Confirm the menu shows {new_text} linking to {new_href}, then return to the Feluda job card and select Mark done.
recipes.validated_by: Feluda build team on the local demo fixture

recipes.element: the contact form's email delivery settings
recipes.title: Fix contact form email delivery
steps: Open {admin_url} and sign in with your builder account. In the left menu select Contact.
In the field labelled Send notifications to, replace the value with exactly {new_text}.
In the field labelled Mail delivery, select On.
Select Save Changes and wait for the notice "Contact form settings saved.".
Do not submit the contact form yourself. Return to the Feluda job card and select Mark done; Feluda sends one tagged test message with the approved test account and checks the test inbox.
recipes.validated_by: Feluda build team on the local demo fixture
